addressing.virtual_stripe: Four physical lines/controller correspond to virtual strides512B. Coalesce only inside actual compatible descriptor extent; no host repack, modulo, reload or borrowed service.

credit.SM_credit_authority: Single authoritative rank/SM ring ledger; no independent shadow pools across controllers. Reservation grants and multiport counter updates unqualified.
credit.SM_credit_release: Destination landing does not free SM ring capacity; only downstream SM consumer releases it.
credit.nonSM_HC: External3072B/SM buffers are separate from landing; CDC/visibility/global barrier waits remain unknown. No free overlap or RF32temporary reserve credit.
credit.rule: Default readiness requires16 free on everyPC; targeted mode uses exact16sector need. Two proposed ports require joint need=sum(port demands) before either grant; independently ready requests can overfill a PC.

cycle_oracle.scope: Finite cycle oracle only; source wait/preparation/CDC/physical clocks excluded

cycle_oracle_actual32PC.scope: Response-only trace with actual32PC map; preissued bursts and required setup/grant cycles explicit, HBM timing/CDC waits unpriced. Synchronized beat phases expose landing collisions; not a sustained service rate.

owner_handshake.next: Bind burst reservation/preparation and increased41/42macro storage to actual descriptor extents, HC/raw writes, barriers and complete source/destination service. Area/route/SSFF remain prerequisite.

ports_and_schedule.two_port_allocation: Two group context banks by group parity; choose one even and one odd to write8 distinct line banks in one cycle. Stalls if complementary free groups/credits unavailable; no peak-rate guarantee.
ports_and_schedule.two_port_request_enqueue: Up to32 sectors accepted/controller/cycle; multiple writes to each64-entry PC queue need explicitly coalesced enqueue indices. Current one-port behavioral loop is not a priced dual-port hardware implementation.

source_wire_contract.oversized_len: Reject0 and17..31. Existing admission only scans16 needs while enqueue scans req_len, and4bit beat would alias. Width5 does not imply a safe31sector burst.
source_wire_contract.write_rule: req_we stays0 on this candidate; writes remain one32B sector with separate commit/fence contract

storage.excluded_unknown_storage: SM authoritative credit allocator logic, CDC and physical rank-age arbitration remain separately unqualified
storage.group_hot_multiport_update: Up to32 response mask writes merge per burst group; up to8 delivered-line updates merge with them. Single live/gen/valid state; duplicate/stale beat checks before credit retirement.

tags.atomic: Reserve group, all per-line immutable contexts and required SM destination ring credits together before req_valid. Stall retains req_addr/req_len/tag and reservations. Raw HC destinations use valid/ready and hold landing on stall.
tags.epoch_oracle_scope: The oracle epoch operand is fault-control metadata, not a controller response wire. Actual epoch/tag-generation reuse requires complete source/controller/landing/destination drain; no implicit epoch field or hardware epoch-fault qualification claimed.
tags.generation: All requested members share generation. Hold complete four-slot group until every requested line is delivered. Increment only then; no wrap before drained epoch transition.
tags.reset: Drain prepared/issued groups, ingress FIFOs, assembled outputs and SM ring consumers before epoch/reset; request acceptance never implies write commit.
tags.short_burst: 1..4 lines use a group prefix; unused suffix remains reserved. No independent reuse inside a live group.

throughput.note: Two-port nominal1.2288TB/s is conditional on queue admission, complementary metadata allocation and delivery. Existing controller has one port. HBM burst timing/refresh/source/destination stalls reduce actual completed service.
